newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 946 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 946 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 946 contracts compared with 1,445 overnight Monday.
There were 74 wheat, 301 corn, 469 soybean, 47 soymeal, 34 soyoil, one oat, one wheat put, two corn calls, 14 soybean calls and three soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to one cent lower, corn was 1-3/4 to 2-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 1-3/4 cents higher to 1/2 cent lower.
